newsitem.title: UK: Hong Kong stocks in London quiet in thin trade.
newsitem.headline: Hong Kong stocks in London quiet in thin trade.

text.p: Hong Kong shares in London were little changed on Monday, with trading thin on the back of a weak Dow, weak FTSE and a weak U.S. Treasury Bond, market makers said.

The Hang Seng London Reference Index was some 3.31 points or 0.02 percent higher at 13,379.00 by 1500 GMT, after the Hang Seng index in Hong Kong closed 69.16 points or 0.51 percent lower at 13,375.69.
HSBC was the only feature in the market, trading at around HK$190, some HK$1.50 above its Hong Kong close, one trader said.
"If it hadn't been for HSBC the index would be down around 20 points," he said.
-- Simon Gardner, London Newsroom +44 171 542 4026 (c) Reuters Limited 1997
